text:
claire: FYI vendor uploaded PT-872 to shared bucket. Quick callout: staging KMS key grants `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-shadow` Decrypt, Dedicated hosts missing SSM session transcripts, API layer strips bodies. Need triage + short mitigation + retest window.
omar: drop the S3 path?
claire: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-872/2026-04-01/report.pdf
omar: thanks. which alias is implicated?
claire: alias/redwood/staging-kms-shadow. policy contains the deploy-shadow principal.
devops-bot: New ticket PT-872-REMED created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-872-REMED :page_with_curl:
omar: immediate mitigation (staging only): create replacement CMK (staging-kms-shadow-v2), point alias to new key, remove deploy-shadow principal from old key policy, re-encrypt any tfstate/encrypted blobs. recommend a "rekey dance" hot-swap: alias shadowing so services pick up new key without downtime.
claire: logging notes from report: 1) Dedicated machines: Session Manager transcripts are not being pushed to S3 (we only have CloudTrail start/end). 2) API: request bodies redacted in logs, recommendation to keep security-only full bodies in encrypted archive for 60 days.
oncall: I can page SRE for an after-midnight window. prefer 02:15-03:30 UTC.
omar: owners: KMS+TF -> omar, SSM transcripts -> claire, API archive pipeline -> oncall. I'll draft exact runbook. Minimal runbook snippet: ```# create new key
aws kms create-key --description "PT-872 staging v2" --policy file://staging-kms-policy.json
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/staging-kms-shadow-v2 --target-key-id <id>
# update services to use alias
# re-encrypt terraform state and secrets
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://state.enc --destination-key-id <new-key-id>```
sec-bot: Evidence bucket initialized: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-872/ (restricted: eng-security)
claire: For evidence we'll need: key creation CloudTrail events, key policy before/after diff, sample SSM transcript object keys (redacted), API body archive metadata (object keys + hash), and a short replay showing exploit path fails.
oncall: I'll schedule the page. if anything unstable during rotation we abort and run rollback alias script. Keep status pings in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
